mainEntity.name: What is the difference between an extra bedroom and an in-law suite?

acceptedAnswer.text: Whether an extra bedroom can function as a legal in-law suite depends on the intended amenities, layout, and privacy level. A standard bedroom addition provides sleeping quarters and a closet, but an in-law suite, mother-in-law apartment, or accessory dwelling unit often incorporates a private bathroom, separate exterior entry, and kitchenette or living space. During your initial consultation, establishing how the space will be used clarifies whether your home needs a simple room extension or a full multigenerational suite.
acceptedAnswer.description: A standard bedroom offers sleeping and closet space, whereas an in-law suite often integrates an en-suite bathroom, separate entrance, and independent living areas.
